{{Quote|Over the years, Thar'quan has disabled many an Imperial facility. He was also one of the major players in the capture of Alpha Outpost, one of the incidents used to distract Imperial forces before the Alliance's activities on Ralltiir.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="CRO-" />}}
The '''capture''' of [[Alpha Outpost]] was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] victory used to distract [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attention from the Alliance's operations on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. The [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Thar'quan]] played a vital role in the operation.<ref name="CRO-" />
